DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Ulcerative Colitis)

The patient's history of mucus discharge, urgency, incomplete evacuation, and relief of pain with defecation strongly suggests a diagnosis of Inflammatory Bowel Disease, specifically Ulcerative Colitis. The mention of a camping trip and other ill party members is likely a red herring or coincidental, as infectious etiologies typically do not present with this specific chronic, four-month duration and "incomplete evacuation" sensation. I will proceed with a colonoscopy and stool studies to confirm the diagnosis and rule out infectious causes.
